messages:
sara: heads-up — nightly eval picked up a big regression on the conversational-qa promptset for rwd-3b-quant8. 24 failures vs 2 baseline, mostly truncated/repetitive answers. attaching quick notes.

eval-bot: alert: nightly-diff: identical-token-rate increased from 4% -> 46% (threshold 10%). failed prompts: 24/200. job_id=job_2026_08_17_03

liam: hmm did we change any sampling behavior in the quant rollout yesterday? I remember a follow-up PR touching the sampler arg plumbing. @sara can you paste the eval config?

sara: eval config snippet (from CI job):
```json
{"model": "rwd-3b-quant8", "sampling": {"temperature": 0.0, "top_p": 0.95, "top_k": null, "seed": 42}}
```

nisha: null top_k stands out. we used to rely on the runtime to omit top_k when null. last week's change added an int-cast utility in sampler args. I bet that turned null -> 0 and we ended up passing top_k=0 to the C++ sampler. top_k=0 semantics there mean "clip to 0 -> degenerate" (weird but true).

liam: can you paste the small helper code that changed? I think it was by the quant team:
```py
# old
def normalize_k(v):
    return v

# new
def normalize_k(v):
    return int(v or 0)

# later: sampler_config.top_k = normalize_k(cfg.get('top_k'))
```

sara: yep that matches the PR. reproducer locally: when top_k ends up 0 the sampler returns single-token repeats very fast, especially at temp=0.0. I repro'd the identical-token spike with the same promptset.

nisha: also saw seed handling oddities — some prompts reuse KV-cache path and we were not reseeding per-example in the harness, so the same seed + top_k=0 made many prompts identical. two orthogonal issues colliding.

liam: proposed fix: (1) treat top_k None as "unset" and do not pass the field to sampler; (2) change normalize_k to return None when unset; (3) ensure eval harness calls rng.seed_random_per_example() — add test. I'll draft a PR.

sara: action items:
- sara: open a revert PR for the normalize_k change and add unit tests for top_k semantics (in sampler args) — urgent.
- liam: add harness-level test to enforce per-example reseed in nightly evals and add a metric assert for identical-token-rate < 12%.
- nisha: instrument sampler to log when top_k==0 at runtime (temp flag) so we can catch regressions faster.

nisha: also adding a quick diff check in the nightly eval webhook to surface identical-output spikes earlier. will post PR link when ready.

devops-bot: deployment queued: revert-sampler-args PR #492 -> staging at 06:10 UTC. CI required: unit + eval-harness tests.

sara: thanks. once revert + tests merge we'll re-run the nightly on a smaller sample immediately to confirm. :thumbsup:

liam: FYI adding a targeted fuzz test that generates sampling-config combos (temp/top_p/top_k/null/ints) — want to catch these plumbing regressions going forward.

sara: agreed. closing the loop here once the rerun is green. thanks all.
